entries.title: A task set to run on your other computer uses only the models it can run
entries.body: A task you set to run on a computer that runs work, and a review that follows its task there, now takes only a model that computer's own sign-ins serve, as Automatic already does, and runs on the sign-in there that serves it. Before, it could be given a model only this computer lists, which the sign-in there does not serve. That computer needs this update too.
entries.noPicture: No screen changes: Task Details already say which computer and model the task runs on.
